title: US2 public Article beta completion is a bounded tests-first lane
summary: Complete only T034, T035, T037, T038, T040, and T041 from main c39288f. Preserve completed T036 and T039, avoid T056, T057+, Web3, deployment, and migrations, and use live PR-head reads rather than serializing a mutable exact-head claim.

claims.text: The authoritative base is main c39288f98279b939401302fe6c50376340db9c6a with T036 and T039 checked and the six selected US2 tasks unchecked.
Historical subject commit 1c94ab2c574a827cf692bc8539f2c5d54f27844e contains the tests-first acceptance and API contract baseline, not a current merge-gate receipt.
Exact-head CI, Security, component, and browser attribution must be read live for the observed PR head and recorded externally so a metadata commit cannot invalidate its own claim.
Local Java 21 and Chromium execution are unavailable; exact-head GitHub workflows are required for those P3 proofs.
Protected merge remains a human gate and is not implied by leaving a reviewable PR.
